NINJA_SLAYER_FEEDBACK_DESCRIPTION_PLACEH: Tell the mod author what went wrong, or leave a suggestion.
NINJA_SLAYER_FEEDBACK_PRIVACY: Your message will be public. Please leave out personal information. Screenshots and logs go only to the mod author and are not public. Logs may include device, save and installed-mod details. This feedback is not sent to MegaCrit.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_FREE_CONTROL_DESCR: Single-player only, during your action phase. Move, drag and attack freely, then return when the turn ends. Runs that use this option are excluded from balance statistics.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_DESCRIPTION: The Ninja Slayer MOD uses run data to balance cards. Ninja Slayer Intel displays aggregate results and players' in-run F2 feedback.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_ENABLED: On. Data is sent when a run ends.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: Off. No run data is sent.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_NOTICE_BODY: The Ninja Slayer MOD uses run data to balance cards. Shared data includes your route, reward choices, final deck, win/loss result and combat statistics. Ninja Slayer Intel displays aggregate results and players' in-run F2 feedback. You can change this later in the mod settings.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_DESCRIPTIO: When enabled, records the route, choices and turn-by-turn actions in subsequent rooms. Ninja Slayer Intel displays the run records anonymously.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_IDLE: No public report is being recorded.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_WAITING: On. Recording starts in subsequent rooms.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_RECORDING: Recording on this device. Submitted when the run ends.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_TRUNCATED: Recording limit reached. Existing data is kept; the report will be marked incomplete.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_STORAGE_ER: Could not save the report locally. Existing files are kept, but the report may have gaps.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_OVERSIZED: The report is too large to upload. It is still saved on this device.
NINJA_SLAYER_TELEMETRY_REPLAY_SUBMITTED: Queued for upload. Failed attempts will retry. Check the site to see whether it was received.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_MANGA_SELECT_DESCR: Use the manga portrait on the character selection screen. Turn off to use the official website artwork. Combat appearance is unchanged.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_BRIEF_BOSS_GREETIN: Turns on after your first full greeting. Manual choices are saved and apply from the next greeting. Press Space during a full greeting to shorten it. In multiplayer, the host chooses the setting and is the only player who can shorten a greeting.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_NARRATION_DESCRIPT: Only affects the narrator. Character voices and music stay on.
NINJA_SLAYER_SETTINGS_RADIO_DESCRIPTION: Tracks have not been added yet. This switch does not currently change the music.
